I added `apps/react-vite/e2e/tests/discussion-comments.spec.ts`. As you asked, I did not run the tests, lint or the app, so it is unverified.

The test follows the smoke test's style and does this:

1. Creates a discussion from the Discussions page and opens it with "View".
2. Adds two comments, checking each one appears and closing its "Comment Created" notification.
3. Opens the delete dialog on the first comment, confirms, and closes the "Comment Deleted" notification.
4. Checks the first comment is hidden, the list has exactly one item, and the second comment is visible.

The per-comment delete button and the confirm button are scoped to the comment's list item and to the dialog. With two comments on the page, an unscoped "Delete Comment" locator would match more than one element.

I did not delete the discussion at the end, unlike the smoke test. Each spec starts from the saved storage state, so the leftover discussion should not affect other tests. Say if you want the cleanup step added anyway.

Nothing was committed.
